final_objective.what_system_does: SuperEzio Financeiro runs a local financial cockpit and Bob pipeline for chart analysis, IBKR paper visibility with real-time/delayed prices and unrealized P&L calculations, penny stock watchlist scanning, and pump & dump forensic detection.
final_objective.who_it_is_for: Marco/F51 as local operator for paper trading, penny stock scanning, and quantitative cockpit validation.
final_objective.main_user_flow: Start the API server, open the UI, view portfolio positions with active market values and unrealized P&L, click positions to update charts, or prompt Bob to scan for cheap stocks (penny stocks) and pump-and-dump anomalies.
final_objective.proof_output: API /health returns ok, /cockpit/portfolio includes real-time prices & P&L, and Playwright smoke tests successfully load the cockpit and render the candlestick charts.

what_was_done: Implemented real-time and delayed market data retrieval (reqMarketDataType(3)) within the IBKR adapter to fetch prices and compute unrealized P&L for all portfolio positions.
Updated graph.py and agent.py portfolio nodes to stream current prices and calculate unrealized P&L for active cockpit rows.
Added penny stocks and pump-and-dump detection support in the market scan node, seeding raw candidates with the pre-vetted PennyLab watchlist.
Expanded _PENNY_OTC_HINTS with Portuguese keywords (e.g. acoes de pouco valor, pump and dump) to route scans correctly.
Restarted the API and CEO servers on port 8002 and 8082, and ran the browser smoke test successfully.

results: Hard restart completed successfully, API and CEO healthy on ports 8002 and 8082.
API route tests successfully passed (25 passed in 6.00s).
Browser smoke test passed with AAPL chart displaying 130 candles and zero console errors.

risks: External market data depends on TWS connection state on port 7497; if TWS is offline, portfolio prices fallback gracefully to average cost.
